help_articles.title: How to Setup Google Gemini AI Sales Assistant on Your Bio Page
help_articles.excerpt: Enable autonomous Gemini 1.5 Flash chat on your public bio website with custom FAQs, business greetings, and instant CRM lead sync.
help_articles.content:
GOOGLE GEMINI AI SALES ASSISTANT SETUP GUIDE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OVERVIEW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
KeyLink360 comes with a built-in Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI Assistant that floats directly on your public bio website. It autonomously answers customer questions, explains products, quotes pricing, and captures customer contacts into your CRM.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP-BY-STEP SETUP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Open Left Sidebar → Bio Pages.
2. Select your bio page or click "Create Page".
3. In the right-side Editor panel, click the "AI Sales Assistant" tab (Sparkles icon).
4. Turn the "Enable AI Sales Assistant" switch ON.
5. Enter your Business Details:
   • Bot Display Name (e.g. Acme Sales Bot)
   • Welcome Greeting Message
   • Business Description & Product Highlights
6. Add Custom FAQs:
   • Add common questions and direct answers (e.g. "What are your delivery times?", "Do you offer COD?")
7. Test the interactive preview in the phone simulator on the right.
8. Click Publish → Your public bio website now has a 24/7 AI Sales Assistant!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CRM LEAD CAPTURE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When visitors share their name, phone number, or email in the chat, KeyLink360 automatically syncs them to Sidebar → Contacts & Leads tagged with "AI Chat Lead" and "Hot Lead".

ta.title: உங்கள் Bio பக்கத்தில் Google Gemini AI சேல்ஸ் அசிஸ்டண்ட் அமைப்பது எப்படி?
ta.excerpt: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI சாட்பாட் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு தானாகவே பதிலளித்து, அவர்களின் தகவல்களை CRM-ல் சேமிப்பது எப்படி.
ta.content:
GOOGLE GEMINI AI சேல்ஸ் அசிஸ்டண்ட் அமைக்கும் முறை

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
கண்ணோட்டம் (OVERVIEW)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
KeyLink360 பிளாட்பார்மில் உள்ளமைக்கப்பட்ட Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI அசிஸ்டண்ட் மூலம் உங்கள் Bio பக்கத்திற்கு வரும் வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு 24/7 தானாகவே பதிலளித்து, விற்பனையை அதிகரிக்கலாம்.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
படிப்படியான வழிமுறைகள் (STEP-BY-STEP)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. இடதுபுற மெனுவில் Bio Pages-ஐ திறக்கவும்.
2. உங்கள் பக்கத்தை தேர்வு செய்து Editor-ஐ திறக்கவும்.
3. எடிட்டரின் வலதுபுறம் உள்ள "AI Sales Assistant" டேப் (Sparkles ஐகான்) கிளிக் செய்யவும்.
4. "Enable AI Sales Assistant" சுவிட்சை ON செய்யவும்.
5. உங்கள் பிசினஸ் விவரங்களை உள்ளிடவும்:
   • Bot Name (எ.கா: Acme Sales Bot)
   • Welcome Message (வரவேற்பு மெசேஜ்)
   • Business Description & Products (பொருட்கள் மற்றும் சேவைகள் பற்றிய விவரம்)
6. Custom FAQs சேர்க்கவும்:
   • வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் அடிக்கடி கேட்கும் கேள்விகள் மற்றும் பதில்கள் (எ.கா: "டெலிவரி நேரம் என்ன?", "COD உள்ளதா?")
7. பக்கத்தில் உள்ள Phone Simulator-ல் உடனடியாக Chat செய்து டெஸ்ட் செய்து பார்க்கவும்.
8. Publish கிளிக் செய்யவும் → உங்கள் Bio பக்கத்தில் Floating AI Chat Widget நேரலையாகிவிடும்!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CRM LEADS சேமிப்பு
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் சாட்டில் தங்கள் பெயர், போன் நம்பர் தரும்போது, அது உடனடியாக Sidebar › Contacts மெனுவில் "AI Chat Lead" டேக்குடன் தானாகவே பதிவாகிவிடும்.

Short answer: Yes.

KEYLINK360 lets you open your bio page on an address you already own instead of the default KEY URL.

You have two main options:

1) ROOT DOMAIN — yourdomain.com and www.yourdomain.com
   → Read: "Story guide: Connect a root domain (yourdomain.com)"

2) SUBDOMAIN — name.yourdomain.com or shop.yourdomain.com
   → Read: "Story guide: Connect a subdomain (name.yourdomain.com)"

Not ready to buy a domain?
   → On Bio Pages, use "Get free URL" for something like yourname.keylink360.in (no DNS setup).

Sidebar → Custom Domains → Connect Domain (button on the top right).

Pick the story guide that matches what you typed in the wizard — root or subdomain — and follow it step by step.

help_articles.title: Connect Domain with Cloudflare (approve each time)
help_articles.excerpt: Each time you connect a domain on Cloudflare, approve KEYLINK360 in the wizard — then DNS is added automatically.
help_articles.content:
HOW CLOUDFLARE CONNECT WORKS

1. Custom Domains → Connect Domain → enter your address and pick a bio page.
2. Choose Cloudflare → tap Connect Cloudflare.
3. Approve KEYLINK360 in Cloudflare (required every time you connect a domain).
4. KEY adds the CNAME (or A for root) in YOUR Cloudflare zone.
5. Status becomes LIVE when DNS + HTTPS are ready.

There is no separate “Cloudflare account Connected” button on Custom Domains. Everything runs inside Connect Domain.

RULES
• Unlimited custom domains / subdomains on each root you own.
• One custom domain per bio page.
• Other DNS hosts: choose Manual and copy the records we show.

KEYLINK360 never writes customer DNS using the platform owner’s Cloudflare account.

You built a bio page in KEYLINK360. You want people to visit YOUR website name — not a long link. You have never touched DNS before. Perfect — read this like a short story.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

A) FREE KEY URL (easiest — no domain needed)
   Example: yourname.keylink360.in
   Where: Bio Pages → Get free URL
   Good when: you are testing or do not own a domain yet.

B) ROOT DOMAIN (your main website name)
   Example: yourdomain.com
   Also opens: www.yourdomain.com
   Good when: you bought yourdomain.com and want that exact name.

C) SUBDOMAIN (a prefix before your domain)
   Example: name.yourdomain.com or shop.yourdomain.com
   Good when: your main site stays somewhere else, but one link should open your KEY bio page.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WORDS YOU WILL SEE (SIMPLE MEANING)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Domain — the website name you type in the browser (yourdomain.com).
• Root / apex domain — yourdomain.com with nothing in front.
• Subdomain — the part before the domain (name. in name.yourdomain.com).
• DNS provider — where you edit DNS records (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, Hostinger, Amazon Route 53, etc.). KEY detects this automatically and shows the name on your domain card.
• A record — points a name to an IP address (used for root domains).
• CNAME record — points a name to another hostname (used for subdomains).
• Connect Domain — the wizard button in Custom Domains.
• Test Connection — checks if DNS is correct after you save records.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
THE FULL JOURNEY (ALL TYPES)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Step 1 — Build and publish your bio page first.
Step 2 — Sidebar → Custom Domains → Connect Domain.
Step 3 — Type your address exactly:
        • Root: yourdomain.com (no www, no https://)
        • Subdomain: name.yourdomain.com (full address including the prefix)
Step 4 — Choose which bio page should open when someone visits that address.
Step 5 — KEY shows which DNS host we detected and the exact records to copy.
Step 6 — Log in to THAT provider (not a random one) and add the records.
Step 7 — Wait 2–15 minutes for DNS to update worldwide.
Step 8 — Back in KEY → Test Connection (plug icon on the domain row).
Step 9 — Status becomes Verified → open your domain in the browser and celebrate.

Status meanings:
• Pending DNS — records missing or still propagating.
• DNS Verified / Provisioning SSL — almost there; HTTPS finishing.
• Verified — live. Share the link.
• OFFLINE on the card — DNS still points elsewhere; fix records and Test again.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHICH GUIDE TO READ NEXT?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

→ Root domain story (yourdomain.com): open "Story guide: Connect a root domain"
→ Subdomain story (name.yourdomain.com): open "Story guide: Connect a subdomain"
→ Exact buttons in the app: open "Step-by-step: Connect Domain wizard"
→ Stuck on Pending DNS?: open "Troubleshooting: domain not verifying"

help_articles.title: Story guide: Connect a root domain (yourdomain.com)
help_articles.excerpt: Follow the yourdomain.com example — from Connect Domain to A record @, Test Connection, and going live.
help_articles.content:
STORY — CONNECTING YOURDOMAIN.COM

You already own yourdomain.com from a registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, etc.). In KEYLINK360 you created a bio page with buttons, WhatsApp, and a product gallery.

You do NOT want to share:
  https://keylink360.in/p/something-long

You WANT people to type:
  yourdomain.com

That is a ROOT DOMAIN connection. Here is exactly what to do.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 1 — OPEN THE RIGHT PAGE IN KEY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Log in to KEYLINK360.
2. Left sidebar → Custom Domains.
3. Top right → Connect Domain.

Do not look for this inside Publish — custom domains live only on the Custom Domains page.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 2 — ENTER THE ROOT DOMAIN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

In the wizard type:
  yourdomain.com

Rules:
• No https://
• No www. (www is handled separately via DNS)
• Just the bare domain: yourdomain.com

Select the bio page that should open → Continue.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 3 — KEY FINDS WHERE DNS LIVES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 checks nameservers and shows your DNS host (for example GoDaddy or Cloudflare).

Important: KEY shows YOUR real provider. Edit DNS there, not somewhere else.

If you bought the domain on Hostinger but moved nameservers to Cloudflare, you edit Cloudflare — trust the name KEY shows.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 4 — ADD TWO A RECORDS (ROOT ONLY)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 shows something like:

  Record 1
  Type: A
  Name / Host: @  (means root — some panels say "@" or leave blank)
  Value / Points to: 69.46.46.90  (use the IP KEY shows on YOUR screen)

  Record 2
  Type: A
  Name / Host: www
  Value / Points to: same IP as above

Log in to your DNS provider → DNS → Add both records → Save.

Cloudflare users: turn Proxied (orange cloud) ON for both records.

Remove OLD A records that point to a previous website host. Duplicate @ records cause "still opens another site" errors.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 5 — WAIT, THEN TEST
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DNS is not instant. Wait a few minutes, then in KEYLINK360:

Custom Domains → yourdomain.com row → Test Connection (plug icon).

First try: Pending DNS (normal if records just saved).
Second try after a few minutes: DNS Verified → then Verified.

You can also expand "Show DNS" on the card to copy values again.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 6 — OPEN THE LIVE SITE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When status = Verified, open your domain.

Both work:
  https://yourdomain.com
  https://www.yourdomain.com

Your KEY bio page opens with HTTPS.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ROOT DOMAIN CHECKLIST (COPY THIS)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

☐ Bio page built and published
☐ Custom Domains → Connect Domain
☐ Entered yourdomain.com (root only)
☐ Picked the correct bio page
☐ Added A record @ → KEY IP
☐ Added A record www → same IP
☐ Removed old conflicting A records
☐ Waited a few minutes
☐ Test Connection until Verified
☐ Opened domain in browser

Note: You only change DNS at your domain provider. If HTTPS is still pending, wait a few minutes and click Test Connection again. See Troubleshooting article if needed.

help_articles.title: Story guide: Connect a subdomain (name.yourdomain.com)
help_articles.excerpt: Follow the name.yourdomain.com example — one CNAME record, Test Connection, and your bio page on a prefix URL.
help_articles.content:
STORY — CONNECTING NAME.YOURDOMAIN.COM

Your company already uses yourdomain.com for the main marketing website (hosted elsewhere). You do NOT want to move the whole domain.

You only want ONE special address for your KEY bio page:
  name.yourdomain.com

That is a SUBDOMAIN. The prefix is name. and the parent domain is yourdomain.com.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ROOT VS SUBDOMAIN — QUICK COMPARE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ROOT (yourdomain.com)
  Records needed: 2 × A records (@ and www)
  Wizard input: yourdomain.com

SUBDOMAIN (name.yourdomain.com)
  Records needed: 1 × CNAME
  Wizard input: name.yourdomain.com  ← type the FULL address including name.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 1 — CONNECT IN KEY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Sidebar → Custom Domains → Connect Domain.
2. Type exactly:
     name.yourdomain.com
   NOT just yourdomain.com
3. Select the bio page that should open → Continue.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 2 — CHECK DNS HOST
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 shows where yourdomain.com DNS is managed — for example Cloudflare or Namecheap.

You must be able to edit DNS for the PARENT zone (yourdomain.com). If your IT team owns DNS, send them the CNAME KEY shows.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 3 — ADD ONE CNAME RECORD
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 shows something like:

  Type: CNAME
  Name / Host: name
    (some panels want only "name", not the full name.yourdomain.com)
  Target / Value: keylink360.in
    (use the exact target KEY shows on YOUR screen)

Cloudflare: Proxied (orange cloud) is OK.

Do NOT add A records for a subdomain connection — use CNAME unless KEY explicitly says otherwise.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 4 — TEST AND GO LIVE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wait a few minutes → Test Connection on the domain row.

When Verified, open:
  https://name.yourdomain.com

Your bio page loads. The main site at yourdomain.com stays unchanged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MORE SUBDOMAIN EXAMPLES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What you type in wizard → CNAME host label

  shop.yourdomain.com     →  shop
  bio.yourdomain.com      →  bio
  link.yourdomain.com     →  link
  studio.yourdomain.com   →  studio

Rule: everything BEFORE the main domain is the host name in DNS.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SUBDOMAIN CHECKLIST
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

☐ Typed FULL subdomain in wizard (e.g. name.yourdomain.com)
☐ Selected correct bio page
☐ Added CNAME with host = prefix only (name, shop, bio…)
☐ Target = KEY hostname shown in app
☐ Test Connection → Verified
☐ Opened https://name.yourdomain.com in browser

help_articles.title: Step-by-step: Connect Domain wizard in KEYLINK360
help_articles.excerpt: Every screen in the Connect Domain wizard — what to click, what to type, and what happens after Done.
help_articles.content:
This guide matches the Connect Domain wizard screen by screen.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BEFORE YOU START
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Have at least one bio page ready.
• Know your domain name (root or full subdomain).
• Know the login for your DNS provider (GoDaddy, Cloudflare, etc.).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCREEN 1 — ENTER DOMAIN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Where: Custom Domains → Connect Domain

1. Type your domain:
   Root example: yourdomain.com
   Subdomain example: name.yourdomain.com
2. Pick which bio page opens on that address.
3. Click Continue.

If the page dropdown says "(in use)", that page already has another domain — pick a different page or remove the old domain first.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCREEN 2 — ANALYZING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 checks nameservers and detects your DNS provider. Wait a few seconds.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCREEN 3 — YOUR DNS PROVIDER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

You see the provider logo and name (e.g. Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Amazon Route 53).

Optional: "Open [Provider] DNS help" opens their official docs in a new tab.

Click Continue.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCREEN 4 — DNS RECORDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEYLINK360 lists exact records to copy:

Root domain → two A records (@ and www) pointing to the platform IP.
Subdomain → one CNAME pointing to the KEY hostname.

Use Copy buttons next to each value.

If Cloudflare for SaaS is enabled, you may also see a TXT ownership record — add it if shown.

Click "I added these records" or verify when ready.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCREEN 5 — SUCCESS / PENDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Verified or DNS Verified → you are live or almost live.
• Still Pending DNS → records not detected yet. Wait and use Test Connection from the domain list.

You can close the wizard — the domain stays on your Custom Domains list.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AFTER THE WIZARD — DOMAIN CARD ACTIONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

On each domain row:

• Domain name — click to open when live.
• Opens: dropdown — change which bio page loads without reconnecting DNS.
• Show DNS — see records again.
• Test Connection (plug) — re-check DNS anytime.
• Refresh — sync SSL/status.
• Trash — remove domain from KEY (does not delete your domain from the registrar).

Badge "DNS at [Provider]" — where you must edit records.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
RECOMMENDED ORDER WITH PUBLISH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Build bio page
2. Connect custom domain (this wizard)
3. Publish (set visibility)
4. Share your brand URL

help_articles.title: Troubleshooting: domain stuck on Pending DNS or OFFLINE
help_articles.excerpt: Test Connection fails? Wrong website opens? Read common fixes — wrong provider, old A records, root vs subdomain mix-ups.
help_articles.content:
STORY — "I CLICKED TEST 10 TIMES BUT STILL PENDING"

You connected yourdomain.com. The card said OFFLINE and Pending DNS. You were editing Cloudflare — but your domain actually used Amazon Route 53. No wonder nothing changed.

Lesson: always edit DNS where the card says "DNS at [Provider]".

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 1 — WRONG DNS WEBSITE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Symptom: You add records but Test never passes.

Fix:
1. Read the badge on your domain row: "DNS at GoDaddy" (example).
2. Log in to THAT site only.
3. Add records exactly as Show DNS lists them.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 2 — ROOT VS SUBDOMAIN MIX-UP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Symptom: Added A records but you wanted name.yourdomain.com.

Fix: Subdomains need CNAME, not @/www A records. Remove wrong records. Re-run wizard with full subdomain typed.

Symptom: Added CNAME but you wanted yourdomain.com.

Fix: Root needs A record @ only. Connect www.yourdomain.com separately as a subdomain (CNAME) if needed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 3 — OLD RECORDS STILL POINTING ELSEWHERE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Symptom: Message says site "still opens another website".

Fix:
• Delete extra @ A records (only one correct IP should remain).
• Remove parking page or old host IPs.
• For www, point to the same KEY IP (or CNAME if your provider requires).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 4 — DNS NOT PROPAGATED YET
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Symptom: Records look correct in provider but KEY says Pending.

Fix: Wait 5–30 minutes. TTL and registrar speed vary. Test again — do not change records every minute.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 5 — HTTPS / SSL STUCK AFTER DNS OK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Symptom: DNS Verified but not Verified yet.

Fix: Wait a few minutes. Click Refresh / Test Connection on the domain row. No hosting panel setup is required — only DNS at your domain provider.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROBLEM 6 — CANNOT DELETE A DOMAIN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Fix: Click trash on the domain row. If error persists, refresh the page and try again, or contact support with the domain name.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STILL STUCK?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Contact Support with:
• Domain name
• Root or subdomain
• Screenshot of DNS records from your provider
• Screenshot of KEY Custom Domains card

We will help you finish the connection.

help_articles.title: What is the difference between Publish and Custom Domains?
help_articles.excerpt: Publish goes live and sets who can see your site. Custom Domains connects and manages your brand domain.
help_articles.content:
Publish vs Custom Domains

Publish (navbar on Dashboard / Account)
• Makes your KEYLINK360 website live
• Shows your public URL
• Lets you choose visibility: Public, Workspace only, or Selected members
• Lets you copy or open the live link after success

Custom Domains (sidebar)
• Connect root domain (yourdomain.com) or subdomain (name.yourdomain.com)
• View DNS instructions and detected DNS provider
• Verify Pending / Verified status
• Remove domains

Recommended flow
1. Build your bio pages
2. Help Center → Custom Domains category → read "Start here: Custom domains for complete beginners"
3. Open Custom Domains → Connect Domain → follow the story guide for root or subdomain
4. Click Publish to go live and share the URL

Tip: Domain connect/manage is only on Custom Domains. Publish is only for go-live and visibility. For a free URL without buying a domain, use Get free URL on Bio Pages.

help_articles.title: How do I publish my first bio page?
help_articles.excerpt: Open Bio Pages, create or edit a page, then use Publish on the Dashboard to make your site live and set visibility.
help_articles.content:
Publishing checklist

1. Finish your page content and cover image in the editor.
2. Save a draft anytime — drafts stay private.
3. On Dashboard or Account, click Publish and choose visibility (public, workspace, or selected members).
4. To use your own brand domain, open Custom Domains in the sidebar (not inside Publish).
5. Copy the public URL or generate a QR code from the QR Codes page.
6. Share the link on social profiles, packaging, or campaigns.

If something looks wrong on the public page, reopen the editor, fix blocks, and publish again.

help_articles.title: How is my workspace data protected?
help_articles.excerpt: Account data is stored in your browser workspace backup and server sync where available. Enable MFA from Account Settings for stronger sign-in protection.
help_articles.content:
Security basics

• Keep your account email up to date under Account Settings.
• Enable MFA for two-factor protection.
• Export regular JSON backups before major imports or device changes.
• Only share public bio URLs — drafts remain private until published.

Privacy
Leads captured by forms stay in your Contacts list. Do not share backup files that contain customer data outside your organization.

help_articles.title: What DNS records do I need?
help_articles.excerpt: Root: A @ → platform IP. Subdomain: CNAME → platform hostname. Copy from Show DNS.
help_articles.content:
KEYLINK360 supports root domains and subdomains.

ROOT (yourdomain.com)
  Type: A
  Name: @
  Value: platform IP (example: 69.46.46.90)

SUBDOMAIN (name.yourdomain.com, www.yourdomain.com, shop.yourdomain.com)
  Type: CNAME
  Name: name (prefix only — not the full domain)
  Value: keylink360.in (or value from Show DNS)

Rules:
• Root → A record only
• Subdomain → CNAME only (never A)

Always copy live values from Custom Domains → Show DNS.

After saving → Test Connection → Verified.
